criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: Information Seeking
categories.definition: Requests for information about COVID-19, including symptoms, transmission, and statistics.

categories.name: Travel Concerns
categories.definition: Inquiries related to travel restrictions, safety, and guidelines during the pandemic.

categories.name: Health and Safety Guidelines
categories.definition: Questions about protective measures, safe practices, and recommendations to avoid infection.

categories.name: Myth Busting
categories.definition: Requests for clarification or information regarding myths and misinformation about COVID-19.

categories.name: Treatment and Recovery
categories.definition: Inquiries about treatment options, recovery rates, and self-care for COVID-19.

categories.name: Donations and Support
categories.definition: Requests for information on how to donate or support COVID-19 relief efforts.

categories.name: Personal Experiences
categories.definition: Expressions of personal feelings or experiences related to COVID-19, including fear and anxiety.

categories.name: Updates and News
categories.definition: Requests for the latest news, updates, and statistics regarding COVID-19.

categories.name: Conspiracy Theories
categories.definition: Inquiries or statements regarding conspiracy theories related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Animal Transmission
categories.definition: Questions about the potential for animals to transmit COVID-19 to humans.

categories.name: Testing and Diagnosis
categories.definition: Inquiries about testing availability, procedures, and what to do if symptoms appear.

categories.name: Community Impact
categories.definition: Questions about the impact of COVID-19 on local communities and businesses.

categories.name: Mental Health
categories.definition: Expressions of concern regarding mental health and coping during the pandemic.

categories.name: Vaccine Information
categories.definition: Inquiries about the availability, effectiveness, and details of COVID-19 vaccines.

categories.name: Surface Transmission
categories.definition: Questions about how long the virus survives on surfaces and related safety concerns.
